$comment: Decisions for scripts/sync-npc-spawns.ts (docs/npc-spawns.md): Wiki spawns it labels in its report, and leaves out of npc-spawns.json when `skip` is true. `categories` are cache NPC categories (opcode 18), `ids` cache NPC ids, `names` cache NPC names, `namePatterns` regular expressions on them, `pagePatterns` regular expressions on the Wiki page title, `boxes` areas ("minX,minY,maxX,maxY[,plane]") such as instance templates a plugin spawns itself.

unalignedLayers.label: Wiki map layer not aligned
unalignedLayers.why: The Wiki draws some dungeons on their own map layers with other coordinates; when too few of a layer's spawns line up with existing ones to work out the shift, its spawns could land in the wrong place.
